propositions: The duration probe must be split into a thin CLI/reporting layer (scripts/rebar_duration_probe.py) and a reusable support module (scripts/rebar_duration_probe_support.py) to stay under the 800-line canonical cap while maintaining stdlib-only dependencies.

Gated-close phase breakdown must separately report pre-verifier residual, deterministic verifier, LLM verifier, verdict-to-status, and status-to-complete intervals, each labeled as direct metric, direct event interval, or inferred residual.
The frozen analysis must be reproducible using the documented CLI contract with explicit defaults for --log-root, --tracker, --since, --until, --provider-prefix, and --current-since.
No-LLM, forced, status/check/help, unmatched, and interrupted operations must remain distinguishable from completed model-backed cohorts in the probe output.

The probe must pass import-walk validation with no import-time side effects and include focused synthetic tests covering command classification, terminal reconstruction, percentile calculation, and cohort filtering.
